summary: The current World Cup Hub system outputs predate the accepted fixture-led application concept, the sole-authority Semantic OS runtime color policy, and the 19 authored component contracts with exact primitive reconciliation. Regenerate the system and emitted tokens from those current sources, preserve the verified visual-asset provenance manifest, and prove that authored token maps survive compilation without generic family fallback.
decisions: Compile only from the accepted fixture-led concept; the previous hero, KPI wall, and generic card-grid composition are not valid fallbacks.
Treat docs/color-reference.md runtime policy as the sole semantic UI color authority and preserve the identity-only raw-color exception namespace.
All 19 authored component token maps must be emitted with token_provenance=authored-input and resolve exclusively to current --ds-* variables.
The 28 primitive reconciliation records and three approved waivers must remain exact after generation.
Preserve the existing visual-asset-manifest/v2 integrated asset and its verified Codex image-generation provenance while refreshing prompt contracts.
Regenerate system artifacts and tokens before any UI implementation or production-readiness claim.

gate_results.evidence: The checked-in generated component_specs.json still contains pre-change generic family token maps and lacks authored-input provenance; in-memory compilation of the accepted source contracts passed 19/19 components and 28/28 primitive reconciliation records.

risks: run-project rewrites generated system artifacts; the compiler must not modify authored brand, component-contract, runtime-theme, or application implementation files.
Prompt regeneration must not downgrade the accepted integrated visual asset or replace its generation-run and candidate provenance with arbitrary strings.
The current output hashes in this dispatch intentionally identify stale artifacts and must be superseded by the compiler completion handoff.
next_action: Ontology Compiler runs run-project and emit-tokens from the current accepted sources, rebuilds image prompt artifacts without losing manifest v2 provenance, validates component contracts and image assets, and returns a schema-valid completion handoff with current hashes.
